fact: The Egyptian Meteorological Authority's training book lists Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) and HRPT satellite reception among the remote sensing facilities available in the Authority, and trains forecasters to use satellite images in forecasting.
system: Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) and HRPT units

fact: Egyptian Meteorological Authority forecasting director Mahmoud Shahin says third-generation satellites give images of the atmosphere about every two and a half minutes, which support forecasting and early warning by tracking clouds, fog and dust storms.
Shahin says the Authority has applied an early warning system since 2020 that combines observation, including satellites, with numerical models to deliver warnings to citizens and agencies.
